inherited_structure: task repertoire associated with substrate attributes
physical_carrier: constructor and substrate implementation; not generally a history-formed record
history_status: history is not primitive in the foundational task definition
future_object: possible or impossible repeatable substrate transformation plus decision-supporting weights in restricted superinformation theories
constraint_type: hard modal possibility under an accuracy and repeatability ideal
dynamics_or_transformation: task performance by a constructor under subsidiary physical laws
admissible_interventions: constructors and resources admitted by the task specification
comparison_or_perturbation: forward task versus inverse task; finite implementation versus limiting constructor; embedding in a reference process theory
observable_algebra: declared substrate attributes and task variables
resource_bound: arbitrarily accurate repeatability; specified resource idealization
scale_or_coarse_graining: depends on substrate decomposition task attributes reference process theory and resource convention
evidence_class: formal frameworks independent process-theory formalization and model-specific photonic experiment
strongest_support: Cleanest native account of hard can/cannot transformations and physical information tasks
strongest_limitation: Does not itself provide objective path probabilities predictive states or a general law of historical inheritance; can be represented within an ordinary process theory absent extra restrictive principles
structural_match_to_icp: partial: maps most naturally to hard transformation possibility not to the whole future-law family
where_analogy_breaks: Task possibility is not path support or probability weight; constructor persistence is not automatically an inherited memory

inherited_structure: multi-time correlations that survive through unobserved degrees of freedom
physical_carrier: environmental degrees of freedom; possibly classical records or coherent quantum memory
history_status: operationally relevant when future statistics depend on prior controls after the reduced present state is reset or conditioned
future_object: future density operators and probabilities for later instruments under control sequences
constraint_type: intervention-indexed probabilistic process; operational hard distinctions only relative to instrument span
dynamics_or_transformation: system-environment evolution contracted with a sequence of CP maps
admissible_interventions: declared quantum instruments or CP maps at each time
comparison_or_perturbation: causal break; comparison with closest Markov product; memory-block instruments
observable_algebra: selected system instrument algebra and final POVMs
resource_bound: tomography basis finite time grid sampling and computational scaling
scale_or_coarse_graining: relative to system-environment cut time resolution and operation set
evidence_class: formal theorems taxonomy and superconducting-qubit experiment
strongest_support: Almost exact realization of a family mapping histories or controls to future operational laws
strongest_limitation: Dilation and state enlargement can absorb memory; carrier is underdetermined; no cross-world coupling of mutually exclusive interventions
structural_match_to_icp: strong within a declared operational boundary
where_analogy_breaks: Not partition-invariant and not proof of a unique physically embodied organization or fundamental irreducible history
claim_level_justified: field_result plus supported and qualified synthesis inference

history_status: history of system-environment interaction is implicit in the present global state
future_object: present fragment measurement statistics and inter-observer agreement

dynamics_or_transformation: unitary system-environment interaction followed by local fragment measurement
admissible_interventions: local measurements on selected environment fragments
comparison_or_perturbation: compare alternative environment decompositions and comparable partitions
resource_bound: access to fragments and redundancy threshold

strongest_limitation: Redundancy can change under decomposition and does not itself cause or constrain later dynamics

future_object: full observational future or future outputs under supplied inputs
